message.content: According to the conversation, Li Hua expressed enthusiasm about diving back into "Call of Duty: Warzone" after the updates. Specifically, during a discussion about upcoming updates, Li Hua stated, "Absolutely! I'm always up for something new in the game. I love exploring fresh content and teaming up with friends! Let’s hop on together when the updates roll out!" This indicates that Li Hua plans to continue playing "Call of Duty: Warzone" once the updates are released.
